info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Banking Operational Services Open Item Management-v5-spec
info.description: The Open Item Management API facilitates the management of open banking operational items, allowing for the creation and handling of unprocessed transactions or requests. This API streamlines the workflow for financial institutions by improving visibility and control over open operational items. Typical consumers include banking operation teams, compliance officers, and risk management departments who need efficient mechanisms to track and resolve outstanding financial items. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency and ensure swift processing of banking transactions.
